races.paceDynamic: Quay Item will likely lead or share early pace with Piping Rock and Treasure Planet prominent, creating a moderate gallop rather than searingly quick fractions. The presence of multiple hold-up horses (Yellow Warning, Vanderflier, Drumlee Orders, Shuil Rocco, Equity Release) suggests the pace will be sustainable early before quickening from the third-last hurdle. With soft ground conditions favouring stamina and rhythm, this race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those that can track the pace, as the hold-up brigade may find too much to do in the testing conditions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Pace Control
scenarios.trigger: If Quay Item and Piping Rock establish a controlled rhythm without serious pressure through halfway.
scenarios.body: These two can dictate comfortable fractions before quickening, making it difficult for the hold-up horses to close effectively on testing ground. The prominent duo have the tactical advantage and proven soft ground form to capitalise.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes pedestrian and the field bunches turning for home.
scenarios.body: Vanderflier or Yellow Warning could benefit from a sprint finish if they've conserved energy, though the soft ground makes this challenging. The race becomes a battle of who has most left in the tank.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Treasure Planet Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Paul Nicholls' runner can overcome his inexperience and travel strongly into contention.
scenarios.body: The four-year-old has shown progressive form and could peak here with Harry Cobden's tactical nous helping him find the right position. His recent Sandown second suggests he's ready to strike.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If The Last Promise builds significantly on his recent Ffos Las run and benefits from the patient ride.
scenarios.body: Henry Oliver's lightly-raced six-year-old could be unexposed and improving, though his poor debut hardly inspires confidence. A market move would be the clearest indication of hidden ability.

watchPoints.text: Watch for significant market moves around The Last Promise, as any confidence would suggest hidden ability from connections
Monitor Vanderflier's jumping early, as his tendency to fade suggests stamina concerns that soft ground will only amplify
Check if Quay Item gets an easy lead or faces pressure from Piping Rock, as this will determine the pace complexion
Observe Yellow Warning's position turning in, as he'll need to be closer than usual given the testing ground conditions
Watch Treasure Planet's travelling on the approach to three out, as this will indicate if he can capitalise on his tactical advantage

races.paceDynamic: Manothepeople will take the lead from the outset but faces no serious pace pressure with the remaining five all possessing prominent or hold-up tendencies. This creates a controlled tempo over the extended 3m2f trip where Manothepeople can dictate fractions without being harassed early. The lack of genuine pace angles means the race will develop into a tactical affair with positioning crucial turning for home. This race shape strongly favors prominent runners who can track the leader and kick when the pace lifts, as there's insufficient early speed to set up the race for closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Manothepeople maintains an uncontested lead and the pace stays steady through the middle stages.
scenarios.body: The front two will have every chance as they're never put under serious pressure until late, allowing them to maintain their advantage when the field closes. Prominent runners get first run on the leader while hold-up horses face too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners move up to pressure Manothepeople approaching the final mile.
scenarios.body: The increased tempo will stretch the field and create a more honest gallop that could bring stamina into play over this extended distance. This scenario opens the door for horses with proven staying power to emerge late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Manothepeople Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If the leader maintains his advantage and none of the prominent runners can mount a sustained challenge.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows Manothepeople to control the race completely and prove too strong when asked for his effort. His superior official rating tells the story if he gets an easy lead.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Closer Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is extremely slow and the race becomes a sprint from the last half-mile.
scenarios.body: Amateur or another patient ride could benefit from a sudden injection of pace late in the piece. However, the lack of early speed makes this outcome highly unlikely over this staying distance.
